events.title: European Space Merger Faces Pushback From Local Competitors
events.body: The friction points to potential hurdles in the regulatory process that awaits Airbus, Leonardo and Thales to get their space merger over the line.

events.title: Dassault Aviation CEO Sees European Fighter Jet Project at Risk of Collapse
events.body: The program might collapse unless Airbus helps reduce friction between the biggest partners on the project, according to Dassault’s Trappier.
